tool_action.public_message: The Orange district is developed, the house shortage is in effect, and the board is set. Let's see how these next few turns play out.
tool_action.private_thought: I have successfully established the Orange monopoly and built 3 houses on each, complementing my 4-house sets on the Pinks. This creates a severe house shortage (only 2 left in the bank). Grok needs 3 houses to reach the 4-house-per-property requirement for his Reds to buy hotels. Therefore, he is currently blocked from building hotels even with his $3,400+ cash. Mortgaging my remaining utility to buy one house wouldn't change his inability to build hotels (he'd still be 1 house short), so I will maintain my current cash for rent payments and keep my utility active.

final_action.private_thought: I have successfully established the Orange monopoly and built 3 houses on each, complementing my 4-house sets on the Pinks. This creates a severe house shortage (only 2 left in the bank). Grok needs 3 houses to reach the 4-house-per-property requirement for his Reds to buy hotels. Therefore, he is currently blocked from building hotels even with his $3,400+ cash. Mortgaging my remaining utility to buy one house wouldn't change his inability to build hotels (he'd still be 1 house short), so I will maintain my current cash for rent payments and keep my utility active.
